description: List the customer's currently-installed app deployments (catalog + custom). Runtime observations (agent 0.6.4+) and last_operation are separate. Read runtime.state, reason, observed_at and age_seconds; unknown/stale/offline is not healthy. Running without a healthcheck is not proven healthy. Container health does not verify the public URL. status and its filter are legacy deployment lifecycle fields, not current availability. Read last_operation.progress for the last reported step and timestamp (agent 0.6.6+), not a live percentage. recovery=resending_result replays a saved result without re-execution; recovery=reconciling (agent 0.6.7+) verifies a completed preparation checkpoint and restores previous configuration without repeating deployment. Wait for a terminal result before retrying. On agent 0.6.8+, recovery=reconciling may also wait for the original supervised pull/build worker to finish successfully before verification and restoration. Never relaunch that work. Missing or invalid completion receipts, failed or timed-out workers, legacy unsupervised work and replacement uncertainty require support (recovery=required). Never retry an interrupted job based only on a timeout. Agent 0.6.12+ controlled builds may recover a verified owned executor after worker loss or host reboot without replay; uncertain identity remains blocked. See deployment-cancellation.html#controlled-builds. On agent 0.6.9+, step=reconciling_replacement waits for the original supervised runtime worker and its final receipt, including normal startup recovery. Never repeat containers or lifecycle hooks; wait for the recorded outcome. Worker loss or an invalid/missing receipt still blocks the queue and requires support. Optionally narrow to a single server via `agent_id`. Use to inspect deployments before adding more, or to find a `deployment_id` to uninstall/restart.

agent_id.description: Optional: narrow to a single server.

status.description: Optional: filter by status (running, failed, installing, ...).

name: impreza_list_deployments
